listening.en: For me, the shine soon wore off the daily challenge app when each new badge began to feel like another demand; I still liked the drawing prompts, so I kept a weekly one and stopped checking the scores every evening.
listening.zh: 對我而言，每個新徽章開始像另一要求時，每日挑戰程式的新鮮吸引力很快退去；我仍喜歡繪畫提示，所以留每周一題，不再每晚查分。
listening.promptZh: 吸引力改變後，保留及改動的是甚麼？

options.en: The speaker kept a weekly drawing prompt but reduced daily score-checking.
options.zh: 說話者留每周繪畫題，減每日查分。

options.en: The speaker found that none of the drawing prompts could still be useful.
options.zh: 說話者發現繪畫提示全再無用。

options.en: The app has removed the drawing prompts and now provides only scores.
options.zh: 程式已刪繪畫提示，現只供分數。

options.en: The speaker increased score-checking because each badge remained as exciting as the first.
options.zh: 每徽章仍如首次興奮，所以說話者加查分。

listening.explanationZh: 徽章變負擔是初期吸引力退，但仍留有用繪畫提示；沒有說程式刪提示，也不是查分更頻密。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼改每周用一次提示？
reply.promptEn: Why did you change to using a prompt once a week?

options.en: The daily badges felt demanding, while the drawing ideas still helped.
options.zh: 每日徽章感有要求，但繪畫想法仍有幫助。

options.en: The shine soon wore off the daily routine, though I still wanted a useful weekly prompt.
options.zh: 每日做法的新鮮吸引力很快退去，但我仍想有用的每周提示。

options.en: I wanted to keep the creative part without turning every evening into another score check.
options.zh: 我想留創作部分，不讓每晚再變查分。

options.en: The first excitement had faded, so I chose a rhythm that suited me better.
options.zh: 初期興奮退了，所以我選較合自己的節奏。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以熱情變化及保留創作作用解釋，不把吸引力退作全無價值。

scene.promptZh: 角色初時很愛新社團的掌聲，幾周後發現每次準備耗時，興奮少了，但仍重視一起演出。哪句準確？

options.en: The shine has worn off the applause for him, but the shared performance still matters.
options.zh: 掌聲對他的初期吸引力退了，但共同演出仍重要。

options.en: He has stopped valuing every part of performing with the group.
options.zh: 他已不再重視跟小組演出的每部分。

options.en: He felt nervous only on the first night and has grown more excited about the applause each week.
options.zh: 他只首晚緊張，之後每周對掌聲更興奮。

scene.explanationZh: 所述是初期掌聲興奮退、仍重視共同演出，不是緊張消散後對掌聲越來越興奮。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 the shine wears off 的本課比喻推出？

options.en: The initial attraction fades.
options.zh: 最初吸引力消退。

options.en: The experience has lost every possible source of value.
options.zh: 該經驗失去所有可能價值。

options.en: The context can compare early excitement with a later response.
options.zh: 情境可比初期興奮及後來反應。

contrast.explanationZh: 新鮮感退不自證所有價值消失。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因你不再愛徽章，就刪全部繪畫提示；你仍每周用一題。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the prompt I still use and change the scoring routine, rather than treat faded novelty as no remaining value.
options.zh: 保留我仍用的提示，改計分做法，不把新鮮感退當全無價值。

options.en: Remove the prompts first and keep only the daily scores so the routine stays measurable.
options.zh: 先刪提示，只留每日分數，讓做法仍可量。

options.en: Return to nightly checking before asking whether the weekly pattern fits better.
options.zh: 未問每周模式是否較合，就回每晚查分。

dialogue.explanationZh: 按實際仍有用部分調，不只追可量分數或未看合用便回舊頻率。

speaking.en: The shine soon wears off when novelty becomes another demand, but I can still choose which useful parts to keep.
speaking.zh: 新鮮感變成另一要求時，初期吸引力很快退去，但我仍可選留有用部分。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清吸引力與持續作用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你修改一段角色日記，他第一次住進熱鬧藝術村很興奮，之後夜晚喧鬧令他難專注，開始不再覺每天都有趣；但仍喜歡白天向鄰居學手藝。你想寫有層次的感受，不把藝術村或居民寫成全壞。用一至兩句英文寫日記。
writing.selfCheckZh: 比較最初興奮與夜噪困難，保留白天學手藝及交流的價值，不以一種感受判所有居民或整段經驗。

examples.en: The shine soon wore off the constant bustle when I could not concentrate at night, though I still enjoyed learning a craft from my neighbours in the daytime. I began to look for a quieter rhythm without dismissing what I had gained.
examples.zh: 夜晚不能專注時，持續熱鬧的初期吸引力很快退去，雖我仍喜歡白天跟鄰居學手藝；我開始找較安靜節奏，不否定所得。

examples.en: The shine soon wore off the noisy evenings, even in a place I had been eager to join. I still valued the daytime conversations, but I needed a quieter night to concentrate.
examples.zh: 即使曾很想加入，吵鬧夜晚的初期吸引力仍很快退去；我仍珍惜日間對話，但需較安靜夜晚才能專注。

takeaways.en: The shine soon wore off the new role when she discovered how often it interrupted her other work, so she asked to review the hours.
takeaways.zh: 發現新角色常打斷其他工作時，初期吸引力很快退去，所以她請檢視工時。

takeaways.en: The shine can wear off quickly, but he wanted to understand which parts of the project still interested him.
takeaways.zh: 初期吸引力可能很快退，但他想了解項目哪些部分仍吸引他。

brief.meaningEn: Gradually tire, discourage or reduce a person’s physical energy or ability to continue through repeated pressure or difficulty.
brief.meaningZh: 反覆壓力或困難逐漸令人疲倦、氣餒，或減低身體精力及繼續做事的能力。
brief.grammar: wear someone/the body down; wore/worn/wearing. Feel/be worn down by + repeated cause is passive. A pronoun object goes between wear and down: wear them down, not wear down them. This fatigue/discouragement sense differs from gradually overcoming someone’s resistance.
brief.register: Common figurative fatigue/discouragement use of wear down, including physical energy when the body is the object. It is not itself a diagnosis, a medical recommendation or proof of permanent incapacity.
brief.boundaryZh: 漸累不等於完全不能做，也不需貶低人；需具體反覆原因，不只一次輕微不便。
brief.misconceptionZh: 持續壓力及可調安排可並存，不把承認疲累當全盤放棄或只歸個人不夠努力。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出累積負擔及提出具體工作調整。

listening.en: The editor felt worn down by repeated last-minute changes to the same captions; she could still review the text, but asked the team to combine comments before sending the next revision.
listening.zh: 編輯被同一圖說反覆最後一刻改動逐漸磨累；她仍能看文字，但請團隊下次修訂前先整合評語。
listening.promptZh: 累積負擔及所提調整是甚麼？

options.en: Repeated late changes were tiring, so she asked for combined comments before another revision.
options.zh: 反覆臨時改動令人累，所以她請再修前整合評語。

options.en: She had received one early comment and refused to read any text.
options.zh: 她只收一次早期評語，便拒讀任何文字。

options.en: The team had already stopped revisions and agreed that the captions were final.
options.zh: 團隊已停修，議圖說為最後版。

options.en: She asked for more separate last-minute messages rather than combined comments.
options.zh: 她要求更多分開臨時訊息，不是整合評語。

listening.explanationZh: 反覆及臨時形成累積，她仍可看，所提是整合而非加零碎訊息。

reply.promptZh: 編輯為甚麼想大家先整合評語？
reply.promptEn: Why does the editor want the comments combined first?

options.en: The same captions kept changing at the last minute.
options.zh: 同樣圖說不停在最後一刻改。

options.en: She felt worn down by the repeated changes and wanted a more manageable revision process.
options.zh: 她被反覆改動逐漸磨累，想修訂程序較可應付。

options.en: Combined comments would reduce the stream of separate revisions she had to revisit.
options.zh: 整合評語可減需反覆再看的分開修訂。

options.en: She could continue reviewing but needed the team to organise the requests differently.
options.zh: 她可繼續看，但需團隊另組要求。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給反覆負擔及流程調整的理由，不自稱完全不能繼續。

scene.promptZh: 角色數周每天被打斷讀信、重講同一往事，感到越來越難集中；她請家人先議每天一段不打斷時間。哪句貼切？

options.en: She feels worn down by repeated interruptions and asks for a more predictable quiet period.
options.zh: 她被反覆打斷逐漸磨累，請有較可預期安靜時段。

options.en: Her concentration difficulty began before these interruptions, which have not changed it.
options.zh: 專注困難在這些打斷之前已有，打斷並未改變它。

options.en: The account concerns one brief interruption on the first day, not a pattern over weeks.
options.zh: 敘述只關首日一次短打斷，不是數周模式。

scene.explanationZh: 所述是數周反覆打斷後越來越難集中，並提出固定安靜時段，不是只一次或完全無影響。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 worn down by 的累積疲累意思？

options.en: Repeated demands gradually make a task feel harder to sustain.
options.zh: 反覆要求逐漸令任務較難持續。

options.en: A person feels unchanged after one brief manageable inconvenience.
options.zh: 一次短小可應付不便後，當事人感沒變。

options.en: A continuing disturbance leaves someone increasingly tired.
options.zh: 持續打擾使某人越來越累。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有累積或漸變線索，不足以用這個意義。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因編輯說累，就把她寫成拒絕全部工作；她說可繼續但需整合評語。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Record the repeated burden and the process change she requested, rather than turn it into a refusal of all work.
options.zh: 記反覆負擔及所求程序改動，不把它變拒全部工作。

options.en: Send another set of separate changes immediately and ask about the process only after she finishes them.
options.zh: 現再寄另一套分開改動，她完後才問流程。

options.en: Remove her from the review without discussing whether combined comments would help.
options.zh: 不談整合評語是否有幫助，就把她從評閱移除。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可累且仍願做，應回應所提負擔，不照舊加或未談便全移除。

speaking.en: I feel worn down by the repeated changes, and I would like us to agree on one way to collect comments before another revision.
speaking.zh: 我被反覆改動逐漸磨累，希望再修前一起議定一種收評語方法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出累積負擔及可調安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫角色內心獨白，他一直獨自照看即將散掉的舊戲服，每次補好又有人不問便拿去，幾周後很累。你想讓他對團隊提出借用前問、用後放回的安排，不把他寫成從此不喜歡戲劇。用一至兩句英文寫他的訊息。
writing.selfCheckZh: 描述重複修補與未問借走的累積，提借還安排並保留戲劇興趣，不把累當永久全拒或指控未知動機。

examples.en: I feel worn down by repairing the same costumes and finding them taken again without a word. Could we agree to ask before borrowing them and put them back after use?
examples.zh: 我反覆補同樣戲服，發現又被不說便拿走，感到逐漸磨累；可否議借前先問、用後放回？

examples.en: I am worn down by the repeated repairs, not by a loss of interest in the theatre. A clear borrowing and return arrangement would help me keep contributing without facing the same confusion each week.
examples.zh: 我被反覆修補逐漸磨累，不是失去戲劇興趣；清楚借還安排可幫我繼續貢獻，不每周面對同樣混亂。

takeaways.en: She was worn down by weeks of conflicting instructions and asked which version the group would follow.
takeaways.zh: 她被數周互相衝突指示逐漸磨累，問小組會跟哪版。

takeaways.en: The volunteers felt worn down by the repeated delays, so they requested a clear update before planning another session.
takeaways.zh: 義工被反覆延誤逐漸磨累，所以再規劃一場前請有清楚更新。

titleZh: 能放鬆喘息、減輕壓力的地方

brief.meaningEn: A place or setting where people feel relief from pressure and have room to be at ease.
brief.meaningZh: 讓人感到壓力紓緩、有餘裕自在的地方或環境。
brief.grammar: need/find somewhere someone can breathe; wanted/found somewhere someone could breathe in a past account. Breathe expresses relief, with a suitable pronoun for the people concerned.
brief.register: Common creative breathing-space image in place-focused wording. It is not a medical statement or proof that the place has particular air quality.
brief.boundaryZh: 放鬆處境不等於所有難題已解，也不必所有人喜同一環境；需描述當事人感受及選擇。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可有安靜或不被催促的空間，不代表人際完全隔離或永遠不用回工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述所需紓壓環境，尊重不同使用方式。

listening.en: After the busy market shift, the volunteers wanted somewhere they could breathe, so we kept a quiet corner where they could sit without answering new requests for ten minutes; the next rota still needed discussion later.
listening.zh: 繁忙市集輪班後，義工想有個能喘息的地方，所以我們留安靜角落讓他們坐十分鐘，不需答新要求；下次值班仍需之後談。
listening.promptZh: 地方提供甚麼，未取代甚麼？

options.en: A short quiet pause from new requests, not the later rota discussion.
options.zh: 短暫安靜、不接新要求，不取代之後值班討論。

options.en: A final decision about the next rota before anyone sat down.
options.zh: 任何人坐下前，已決定下次值班。

options.en: A new task desk where volunteers must answer requests throughout the break.
options.zh: 新工作枱，義工整段小休必答要求。

options.en: The quiet corner replaces the later rota discussion rather than providing a short break before it.
options.zh: 安靜角落取代之後值班討論，而非先給短暫小休。

listening.explanationZh: 安靜十分鐘是不接新要求的短歇，值班討論仍要之後做；不是已定值班、新工作枱或用休息取代討論。

reply.promptZh: 輪班後你們為甚麼留安靜角落？
reply.promptEn: Why did you keep a quiet corner after the shift?

options.en: The volunteers needed a short pause without responding to more requests.
options.zh: 義工需短暫不再答要求的小休。

options.en: They wanted somewhere they could breathe after the busy shift.
options.zh: 忙碌輪班後，他們想有能喘息的地方。

options.en: The corner let people sit for ten minutes before returning to later plans.
options.zh: 角落讓大家坐十分鐘，再回之後計劃。

options.en: We wanted a brief space for relief, not another place to assign tasks.
options.zh: 我們想有短暫紓緩空間，不是再派工作的地方。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以不接新要求的短歇解釋，不取消後續責任。

scene.promptZh: 故事中孩子放學後喜歡到祖父的小工作間坐，因可先不說話、不被催交代成績；祖父仍會在他願意時聽。哪句合適？

options.en: The workshop is somewhere he can breathe, with no pressure to speak before he is ready.
options.zh: 工作間是他能喘息的地方，未準備好時不被逼說。

options.en: The workshop requires him to report every mark before sitting down.
options.zh: 工作間要求他坐前報每個分數。

options.en: He goes there only to finish a timed homework task, not to sit without a demand.
options.zh: 他只到那完成限時功課，不是沒要求地坐一坐。

scene.explanationZh: 可以先不說、不報成績而祖父仍願聽，形成放鬆條件；不是先報成績或只做限時功課。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 somewhere they can breathe 的本課比喻推出？

options.en: The setting offers some relief from pressure.
options.zh: 環境提供一些壓力紓緩。

options.en: The speaker has measured a medical improvement in breathing.
options.zh: 說話者已量出呼吸的醫學改善。

options.en: The people’s preferences help explain why the place feels restful.
options.zh: 當事人偏好幫解釋何以感休息。

contrast.explanationZh: 此處喘息是處境感受，不是醫療測量。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把義工休息角也放一疊急問卷，要求坐下即填；你原想給十分鐘不接要求。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the short pause free of new tasks and ask about the questionnaire after the break.
options.zh: 讓短歇不接新任務，小休後再問問卷。

options.en: Put the urgent questionnaire on every seat so the break can complete another job.
options.zh: 每座放急問卷，讓小休再完成另一工作。

options.en: Cancel the quiet corner because the rota discussion still has to happen later.
options.zh: 因之後仍需談值班，就取消安靜角落。

dialogue.explanationZh: 短歇可與之後工作並存，不用再派任務或因還需工作就全取消。

speaking.en: We need somewhere we can breathe for a few minutes, without treating that pause as the end of every responsibility.
speaking.zh: 我們需有地方喘息幾分鐘，不把小休當所有責任已完。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再描述放鬆環境與有限時段。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替朋友比較兩處短住寫作地方：一處宣傳絕對安靜，卻遠離他熟悉的人；另一處有安靜房間也可選到共用廚房聊天。他已說獨處太久會緊張，想有選擇而非完全隔離。你想回覆哪處更像他能喘息的地方，先請他確認，不替他決定。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: You said you need somewhere you can breathe without feeling cut off, so the room with an optional shared kitchen may suit you better. Does having a choice between quiet writing and company sound closer to what you want?
examples.zh: 你說想有能喘息又不覺隔絕的地方，所以有可選共用廚房的房間或較適合；可選安靜寫作或有人陪，是否較近你所想？

examples.en: Somewhere you can breathe need not mean complete isolation, given what you told me about being alone too long. I would compare the two places by the choice they offer, then let you decide whether either fits.
examples.zh: 按你說獨處太久的感受，能喘息的地方不必完全隔離；我會按可選方式比兩處，再讓你決定有沒有合適。

glossary.zh: 可選擇使用的共用廚房

writing.selfCheckZh: 依朋友明說的需要比較環境與選擇，先確認喜好，不把宣傳安靜等同一定適合或替他決定。

takeaways.en: The courtyard became somewhere they can breathe between the crowded sessions, with seats away from the registration queue.
takeaways.zh: 院子有遠離登記隊的座位，成了他們在擠迫活動間可喘息的地方。

takeaways.en: I am looking for somewhere I can breathe and think before answering another invitation.
takeaways.zh: 我正找可喘息思考的地方，再答另一邀請。

brief.meaningEn: Possible to achieve, obtain or afford in the stated circumstances.
brief.meaningZh: 在所述情況下，有可能達到、取得或負擔得起。
brief.grammar: be/seem/bring something within reach; within reach of someone; this attainable sense differs from physical hand-reaching distance.
brief.register: Established reach-as-attainability phrase. Prospects depend on the stated conditions and are distinct from a completed outcome.
brief.boundaryZh: 可望不等於已到手或必成功；需交代可行條件，不由感覺推具體金額或資格。
brief.misconceptionZh: 目標可接近達成而仍有步驟未完，不能把有機會寫成已獲批。
brief.outcomeZh: 能有依據表達可望達成，保留剩餘工作。

listening.en: With the interviews transcribed and only the introduction left, a complete draft by Sunday seemed within reach, provided we kept the afternoon we had reserved for it.
listening.zh: 訪談已打好，只餘介紹，若保留已預留下午，周日前有完整草稿看來可望達成。
listening.promptZh: 可望達成的條件及待做部分是甚麼？

options.en: The draft may be complete by Sunday if the reserved afternoon is kept for the remaining introduction.
options.zh: 若留預定下午寫餘下介紹，周日前可能完草稿。

options.en: The introduction has already been finished and the draft has been accepted for publication.
options.zh: 介紹已完，草稿已獲刊登接納。

options.en: No work has begun, so the Sunday prospect is based only on wanting it.
options.zh: 尚未開始工作，所以周日希望只基於想要。

options.en: The afternoon has been cancelled and a later completion date agreed.
options.zh: 下午已取消，並議較後完成。

listening.explanationZh: 已有轉錄及預留時間支持希望，介紹仍要做，不是已獲接受或完全未開始。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你覺得周日有完整草稿是可行的？
reply.promptEn: Why does a complete draft by Sunday seem realistic?

options.en: The interviews are transcribed and we have an afternoon reserved for the introduction.
options.zh: 訪談已打，並留下午寫介紹。

options.en: The finished draft seems within reach because only the introduction remains and time is set aside.
options.zh: 只餘介紹且留了時間，所以完成草稿看來可望達成。

options.en: Most of the material is ready, with a clear remaining task and a planned work period.
options.zh: 大部分材料已備，有清楚餘下任務及已計劃工作時段。

options.en: The prospect follows from our progress and the time we still have, not from publication being confirmed.
options.zh: 希望來自進度及仍有時間，不是刊登已確認。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給進度及時間條件，未把有望作已完成。

scene.promptZh: 故事角色想租一天展覽攤位，手上可用的活動代幣有八個，攤費要十二個，且主辦人已說本輪沒有折讓；她尚無額外來源。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The stall is not yet within reach with the tokens she currently has, so she needs another workable arrangement.
options.zh: 按目前代幣，攤位仍未能負擔，需另一可行安排。

options.en: Knowing the quoted fee is enough to call the stall within reach, without considering how she would cover it.
options.zh: 知道報價已足以稱攤位可負擔，不用考慮怎付足。

options.en: The organiser has agreed to accept eight tokens for this round’s stall.
options.zh: 主辦人已同意本輪攤位只收八代幣。

scene.explanationZh: 八不足十二且無折讓，按現有資源仍未可；知道報價不等於已可負擔，亦未獲減費。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 within reach 的可達成意思推出？

options.en: The goal appears possible under the relevant conditions.
options.zh: 目標在相關條件下看來可能。

options.en: The outcome has already been secured.
options.zh: 結果已確保到手。

options.en: Some steps may still be needed before reaching it.
options.zh: 到達前仍可能有步驟要做。

contrast.explanationZh: 可達不是已得，需保留條件及進度。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因周日草稿有望，就把預留下午全改去拍宣傳照；介紹還沒寫。哪個回應最好？

options.en: The goal is within reach if we keep time for the introduction, so let us protect that slot before adding another task.
options.zh: 若留時間寫介紹，目標可望達；加另一任務前先保該時段吧。

options.en: Use the afternoon for photographs and leave the introduction until after the draft is sent.
options.zh: 下午拍照，草稿送出後才寫介紹。

options.en: Announce that the draft is finished because the interviews have been transcribed.
options.zh: 訪談已打，所以宣布草稿已完成。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可望靠仍需做的介紹及預留時間，不以部分進度代全完或移走必要時段。

speaking.en: The goal is within reach, but I still need to protect the time and finish the part that remains.
speaking.zh: 目標可望達成，但我仍需保留時間、完成餘下部分。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再交代可行條件及未完部分。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你向原怕學不會打結的角色寫鼓勵信。他已能慢慢完成前兩步，最後一步在有提示時也成功，想下次試不看提示。你要以進度說目標有望，請他先重試一個結、需要可再看提示，不把一次成功稱全面精通。用一至兩句英文鼓勵。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以已會步驟及有幫助成功支持下一小步，留可查指引，不把有望等同已精通或不准求助。

examples.en: Doing one knot without the prompt is within reach, given the steps you can now complete. Try one more slowly, and keep the guide nearby if you need to check the last step.
examples.zh: 按你現能完成步驟，一個結不看提示可望做到；再慢試一個，指引留旁邊，需時可核最後步。

examples.en: The next goal seems within reach because you have already managed the final step with help. Let us try one knot without looking first, while keeping support available rather than treating this as a test of your worth.
examples.zh: 你有幫助時已做到最後步，所以下目標看來有望；先試一個不看，仍留支援，不把它當個人價值測驗。

takeaways.en: A complete first version was within reach once the group had gathered the material and set aside a final writing session.
takeaways.zh: 材料集齊並留最後寫作時段後，完整首版可望達成。

takeaways.en: The tutor said the next task was within reach, while reminding us to check the step we still found difficult.

titleZh: 被接納及有所連結的歸屬感

brief.meaningEn: A feeling of being accepted, included or connected to a group or place.
brief.meaningZh: 感到被接納、包含在內，或與群體、地方連結。
brief.grammar: give/develop/feel a sense of belonging; describe what supports the feeling for the person concerned.
brief.register: Natural noun phrase. A reported feeling may be individual and limited; it does not prove that all people experience inclusion equally.
brief.boundaryZh: 歸屬感不等於每事同意、全無分歧或人人已成密友；需看實際參與及當事人感受。
brief.misconceptionZh: 身在場所或列名單不自動表示感被接納，也不能替未發聲者宣告感受。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體互動解釋歸屬感，保留個人及群體差異。

listening.en: The new member said that being asked which story she wanted to discuss gave her a sense of belonging; she had been on the mailing list for weeks, but this was the first time her choice shaped the meeting.
listening.zh: 新成員說，別人問她想談哪故事，讓她有歸屬感；她在郵寄名單已有幾周，但首次由她的選擇影響聚會。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼讓她感到被包含？

options.en: Her choice was invited and helped shape the meeting, beyond simply being on a list.
options.zh: 她獲邀選擇並影響聚會，不只在名單。

options.en: The mailing list alone had already made her feel fully involved before anyone asked her.
options.zh: 未有人問她前，只列郵寄名單已讓她感充分參與。

options.en: The group selected her story without asking what she wanted.
options.zh: 小組沒問她所想，便選她故事。

options.en: She had already been leading every discussion since joining the list.
options.zh: 加入名單後，她已帶每次討論。

listening.explanationZh: 她說的改變是選擇影響會議，非名單本身或已一直主持。

reply.promptZh: 新成員為甚麼說這次有歸屬感？
reply.promptEn: Why did the new member say she felt included this time?

options.en: The group asked what she wanted to discuss and used her choice.
options.zh: 小組問她想談甚麼，並用其選擇。

options.en: Having her choice shape the meeting gave her a sense of belonging.
options.zh: 她的選擇影響聚會，給她歸屬感。

options.en: She was participating in a decision rather than only receiving the mailing list.
options.zh: 她參與決定，不只收郵寄。

options.en: Her preference mattered to what the group actually did that day.
options.zh: 她的偏好對小組當天實做的事有影響。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以被問及實際影響支持她個人感受。

scene.promptZh: 新成員已拿到會員卡，卻說開會時仍沒人記得她的名字，她也不知道問誰，還未感覺自己屬這小組。哪句準確？

options.en: Formal membership has not yet given her a sense of belonging; her account still describes being unrecognised and unsure where to ask.
options.zh: 正式會員身分還未給她歸屬感；她仍說沒被記得，也不知問誰。

options.en: Receiving the card has already made her feel recognised and comfortable asking the group for help.
options.zh: 收到卡已令她覺被認識，也自在地向小組求助。

options.en: Her concern is that the membership card has expired, rather than how she experiences the meetings.
options.zh: 她擔心的是會員卡過期，不是聚會感受。

scene.explanationZh: 有卡是身分，尚無歸屬是本人感受；未說已自在或卡過期。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以證明 someone has a sense of belonging？

options.en: They say their participation makes them feel accepted.
options.zh: 他們說參與令感被接納。

options.en: Their name appears on a list, with no evidence about their experience or feeling.
options.zh: 名字在名單，但無其經驗或感受資料。

options.en: They describe a connection with the group through a shared activity.
options.zh: 他們描述透過共同活動跟小組連結。

contrast.explanationZh: 名單身分不自證主觀歸屬感，需互動或本人回應。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因一人有歸屬感，就在回顧寫全組都無隔閡；尚未問其他人。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Report what she said and ask others about their experience before generalising to the whole group.
options.zh: 報她所說，概括全組前先問其他人的經驗。

options.en: Use her response as the whole group’s view and omit the invitation for further comments.
options.zh: 把她回應當全組看法，省再收意見邀請。

options.en: Keep only membership numbers and leave out the specific choice she said mattered.
options.zh: 只留會員數，刪她說重要的具體選擇。

dialogue.explanationZh: 既保留個人具體感受，也不讓一人代表全體或只留人數。

speaking.en: A shared decision gave me a sense of belonging, even though I was still learning how the group worked.
speaking.zh: 共同決定讓我有歸屬感，雖我仍在學小組怎運作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再以具體參與解釋個人感受。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為互助社團寫邀請，希望新成員也能有歸屬感，但不要求每人即說私事。你提議可先帶一件小物、選擇只聽或講一句意義，之後問他們覺得參與方式是否自在，而非預先宣告大家已融入。用一至兩句英文寫安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提出不同自願參與方式並事後問感受，不要求揭私事或把期待寫成全員已有歸屬。

examples.en: We hope the object-sharing activity can help newcomers develop a sense of belonging without requiring personal disclosure. They may listen or say one sentence, and we can ask afterwards how the choice felt.
examples.zh: 我們希望分享小物活動幫新人有歸屬感，不要求披露私事；可只聽或說一句，之後再問選擇感覺怎樣。

examples.en: A sense of belonging should grow through a welcome that leaves room for different ways to join. Let us offer listening or a short comment, then ask new members whether the arrangement felt comfortable.
examples.zh: 歸屬感應從容許不同加入方式的歡迎中成長；可提供聆聽或短評選擇，再問新成員安排是否自在。

takeaways.en: Choosing the questions together helped the newcomers develop a sense of belonging in the group.
takeaways.zh: 一起選問題幫新成員在小組建立歸屬感。

takeaways.en: She described a sense of belonging when her neighbours remembered the idea she had offered and invited her back.
takeaways.zh: 鄰居記得她提過的想法並再邀她時，她描述有歸屬感。

brief.meaningEn: Physical buildings or the built environment, often contrasted with the social activity that gives a place meaning.
brief.meaningZh: 有形建築或建成環境，常與賦予地方意義的社群活動作對比。
brief.grammar: more than bricks and mortar; invest in/describe the bricks and mortar; this noun expression differs from the hyphenated brick-and-mortar adjective for physical business premises.
brief.register: Established materials-as-buildings expression. It does not deny that buildings are necessary or that their design affects access.
brief.boundaryZh: 不只建築不等於建築不重要；需分清空間設施及讓人參與的安排，不把漂亮場所當已成社群。
brief.misconceptionZh: 牆及房間可提供場所，仍需有人際活動、接待及使用方式。
brief.outcomeZh: 能比較有形場地與社群運作，說明兩者怎配合。

listening.en: The new centre had the bricks and mortar, with bright rooms and a repaired entrance, but residents said it still needed a clear welcome and activities they could help shape.
listening.zh: 新中心已有有形場地，房間明亮、入口已修，但居民說仍需清楚接待及他們可幫塑造的活動。
listening.promptZh: 已具備及仍需的是甚麼？

options.en: The building improvements exist, while welcome and participatory activities still need attention.
options.zh: 建築改善已有，接待及可參與活動仍需處理。

options.en: The centre has only a proposed floor plan and no repaired rooms available yet.
options.zh: 中心只有擬議平面圖，尚未有修好可用房間。

options.en: Residents have already chosen the activities and begun using the new welcome arrangement.
options.zh: 居民已選好活動，並開始使用新接待安排。

options.en: The report concerns only materials stored for a future building, not an existing centre.
options.zh: 報告只關未來建築所存材料，不是已有中心。

listening.explanationZh: 明房及修好入口已在，接待及可讓居民參與的活動仍需規劃；不是只有圖則，也不是活動及接待已實施。

reply.promptZh: 居民為甚麼說中心仍需努力？
reply.promptEn: Why do residents say the centre still needs work?

options.en: The rooms are ready, but people still need a welcome and a voice in the activities.
options.zh: 房間備好，但大家仍需接待及活動發言權。

options.en: It has the bricks and mortar, but the social use of the space still needs planning.
options.zh: 已有有形建築，但空間的社群使用仍需規劃。

options.en: A repaired building does not by itself decide what residents can do there.
options.zh: 修好的建築本身沒決居民可在那做甚麼。

options.en: They want the physical space connected to ways people can actually take part.
options.zh: 他們想把實體空間連到實際參與方法。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都分場地與活動使用，不否定入口改善。

scene.promptZh: 學校紀念冊已有新樓照片，但你想補學生如何用走廊展草稿、互問問題，讓故事不只有建築。哪句合適？

options.en: The account should include more than bricks and mortar by showing how students use the spaces to share work.
options.zh: 敘述應不只有建築，也展示學生怎用空間分享作品。

options.en: The added scenes should focus on the architect’s plans instead of how students use the corridors.
options.zh: 新增場景應集中建築師圖則，而非學生怎用走廊。

options.en: The anniversary book already contains students’ accounts of using the corridors and needs no additional material.
options.zh: 紀念冊已有學生使用走廊的敘述，不需再加材料。

scene.explanationZh: 所求是照片以外學生實際使用空間的故事；不是再只談圖則，也未說那些學生敘述已收錄。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 bricks and mortar 的本課用法？

options.en: The rooms and entrance of a community building.
options.zh: 社區大樓的房間及入口。

options.en: The feeling of being welcomed by a neighbour, without reference to any physical premises.
options.zh: 被鄰居歡迎的感受，不涉及任何實體場地。

options.en: The physical structure that houses a group’s activities.
options.zh: 容納小組活動的有形建築。

contrast.explanationZh: 歡迎感受是社會經驗，不是有形建築本身。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說要加活動，所以入口修好就不用寫；但入口改善讓更多人可進。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the useful building change and explain how it supports the activities people want to join.
options.zh: 保留有用建築改動，解它怎支持大家想參加的活動。

options.en: Remove the entrance information and describe only the activity titles without how people reach them.
options.zh: 刪入口資訊，只列活動名，不說大家怎到。

options.en: Use only room photographs and leave out the residents’ ideas for using them.
options.zh: 只用房間照片，刪居民使用想法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有形可接達與社群參與可連起，不需要只留其中一面。

speaking.en: The centre needs more than bricks and mortar, but its rooms and entrance can help make the social activities accessible.
speaking.zh: 中心不只需建築，但房間及入口可幫社群活動容易接達。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再連建築及實際使用方式。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫一封致謝信給借出舊店作每周棋會的人，不想只讚場地。你要說空間重要，也感謝他讓新手隨時問規則、讓常客輪流陪下，令店不只是一間房，不聲稱每人已成好友。用一至兩句英文道謝。
writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝實體空間及耐心迎新方式，指出新手提問輪流陪下，不把建築或好意自動當所有關係已密切。

examples.en: Thank you for offering more than bricks and mortar: newcomers can ask about the rules, and regular players take turns to sit with them. The room matters because it gives that welcome a place to happen each week.
examples.zh: 謝謝你提供的不只有形場地；新手可問規則，常客輪流陪下。場地很重要，因它讓這樣的接待每周都有地方進行。

examples.en: Your shop is more than bricks and mortar to the chess group because you make room for beginners to join. I appreciate both the space and the patient welcome you encourage.
examples.zh: 你讓新手有位置加入，所以店對棋會不只有形建築；我感謝空間，也感謝你鼓勵耐心迎新。

takeaways.en: The report covered the bricks and mortar of the new hall before asking how local groups would use it.
takeaways.zh: 報告先談新禮堂實體建築，再問本地小組怎用。

takeaways.en: The school’s story was more than bricks and mortar; the interviews showed what happened in its rooms.
takeaways.zh: 學校故事不只有建築，訪談展示房內發生的事。

titleZh: 服務中的體貼與人情味

brief.meaningEn: Personal warmth, care and attention to the person involved, especially in a service or response.
brief.meaningZh: 對當事人的個別溫暖、關懷及留意，尤其在服務或回應中。
brief.grammar: a/the human touch; add/give/need a human touch; article varies with whether the quality is introduced or referred to generally.
brief.register: Established phrase. It can be present in written or remote service, not only physical contact or doing everything by hand.
brief.boundaryZh: 有人情味不證服務已解所有問題，也不是只要人手做便好；需有回應個別需要的線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 自動流程可與個人關懷並存，不必把有效工具全撤去或要求肢體接觸。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述具體體貼回應，分清流程效率及個人關懷。

listening.en: The standard reply gave the opening hours, but Jo added a human touch by answering the visitor’s question about a quiet time to come, without promising that the whole building would be empty.
listening.zh: 標準回覆給開門時間，但 Jo 回應訪客何時較安靜可來的問題，加了人情味，沒有承諾整樓會空。
listening.promptZh: 人情味體現在甚麼？

options.en: Jo answered the individual concern about a quieter visit while keeping the promise realistic.
options.zh: Jo 回應較安靜到訪的個別顧慮，並保持實際承諾。

options.en: Jo removed the opening hours and sent only a general greeting.
options.zh: Jo 刪開門時間，只寄一般問候。

options.en: The standard reply had already addressed that visitor’s specific quiet-time question.
options.zh: 標準回覆已處理該訪客具體安靜時段問題。

options.en: Jo guaranteed a private building with no other visitors.
options.zh: Jo 保證整樓只給一人，沒其他訪客。

listening.explanationZh: 個別安靜顧慮有回應，不是刪有用時間或過度保證。

reply.promptZh: Jo 的回覆為甚麼較體貼？
reply.promptEn: Why was Jo’s reply more considerate?

options.en: She addressed the visitor’s own question about when it might be quieter.
options.zh: 她回應訪客本人何時可能較安靜的問題。

options.en: She added a human touch by responding to a concern the standard hours did not answer.
options.zh: 她回應標準時間沒答的顧慮，加了人情味。

options.en: The reply went beyond the general information to consider the person’s visit.
options.zh: 回覆在一般資訊以外，也考慮個人到訪。

options.en: It kept useful practical details and made space for the visitor’s preference.
options.zh: 它保留有用實務資訊，也留意訪客偏好。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給個別關懷的具體表現，不把人手或肢體接觸當唯一依據。

scene.promptZh: 遠方導師給錄音評語，先提學員上次努力改善的停頓，再說一項下一步；雖不見面，學員覺有被留意。哪句貼切？

options.en: The recorded feedback has a human touch because it responds to the learner’s particular progress.
options.zh: 錄音回饋有體貼人情味，因回應學員具體進度。

options.en: The feedback cannot show personal care because the tutor is not in the same room.
options.zh: 導師不同房，所以回饋不能顯個人關懷。

options.en: The tutor gave every learner the same comment without referring to this learner’s work.
options.zh: 導師給每位學員同樣評語，沒提這學員作品。

scene.explanationZh: 媒介遠方仍可留意具體努力，不因不共處便否定，也不是無個別指涉。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以證明 a human touch？

options.en: A response notices a person’s particular question and answers it thoughtfully.
options.zh: 回應留意個人具體問題並仔細答。

options.en: A process is done manually but ignores the person’s stated concern.
options.zh: 程序人手做，卻忽略對方已說顧慮。

options.en: A short note acknowledges someone’s effort and gives relevant guidance.
options.zh: 短便條肯定某人努力並給相關指引。

contrast.explanationZh: 手做本身不等於關懷，要看回應人。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因需人情味，就刪去清楚標準開門時間，每封從頭寫；你想留效率及個別回應。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the accurate standard details and add a thoughtful answer to the person’s particular question.
options.zh: 留準確標準資訊，再加對個人問題的仔細答案。

options.en: Write a fresh greeting each time but leave the quiet-time question unanswered.
options.zh: 每次新寫問候，卻不答安靜時段問題。

options.en: Send only the fixed hours and close the enquiry before considering the visitor’s concern.
options.zh: 只發固定時間，未考慮顧慮便結查詢。

dialogue.explanationZh: 效率及體貼可結合，不以新寫問候代實際回應，也不只留固定資訊。

speaking.en: A human touch can come from noticing the person’s question, even when the rest of the process is simple and standard.
speaking.zh: 即使其他流程簡單標準，留意個人問題也可帶人情味。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用具體留意解釋體貼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你給借你筆記的朋友寫還書便條，知道他下周要教同一段，想謝他並標出你找到的一條學生提問，讓他較易準備。你不想只送一句制式謝謝，也不改他原筆記。用一至兩句英文寫這個有個人留意的回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以朋友下周所教內容加具體問題作心意，分開建議及原筆記，不只套問候或擅改作品。

examples.en: I wanted to add a human touch to my thanks by marking the student question that may help with your lesson next week. I have kept your original notes unchanged and placed my suggestion on a separate slip.
examples.zh: 我想標出可能幫你下周課的學生問題，讓道謝多一點個人心意；原筆記未改，建議放另紙條。

examples.en: Thank you for lending me the notes; I have left a short question on a separate slip for the class you are preparing. I hope that small detail gives the return a human touch, without changing your work.
examples.zh: 謝你借筆記；我另放一張短問題紙條，給你正備的課，希望小細節讓歸還有點人情味，不改你作品。

takeaways.en: The handwritten note added a human touch by remembering the question she had asked at the previous visit.
takeaways.zh: 手寫便條記得她上次問過的問題，加了體貼人情味。

takeaways.en: Efficient booking kept the process simple, while a personal reply supplied the human touch when someone needed help.
takeaways.zh: 有效預約讓流程簡單，有人需幫時，個別回覆提供體貼人情味。

target.pattern: \bmakes? a living\b|\bmaking a living\b|\bmade a living\b

brief.meaningEn: Earn money through work to support everyday life.
brief.meaningZh: 透過工作賺取維持日常生活的金錢。
brief.grammar: make a living by + -ing/from + work/as + job; made/making; distinguish livelihood from a hobby, a single gift or guaranteed wealth.
brief.register: Established everyday livelihood phrase. It does not specify an income amount, financial security or whether the work is someone’s sole interest.
brief.boundaryZh: 謀生不等於發財、一定穩定或只做一種工作；需說收入來源，不把有愛好當已靠它養活自己。
brief.misconceptionZh: 熱愛藝術與靠其他工作維持生活可並存，不能由收入來源推一個人內心所重視全部。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確介紹工作收入來源，分清興趣與謀生。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Many musicians teach to make a living.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 37, table 1, row 9; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Rosa makes a living by repairing costumes for several theatre groups, while writing poems remains something she does in her own time; the profile does not say the poems bring her an income.
listening.zh: Rosa 替幾個劇團修戲服謀生，寫詩仍在私人時間做；人物介紹沒說詩帶來收入。
listening.promptZh: 已說明的謀生來源是甚麼？

options.en: Costume repair brings her income, while paid poetry work is not established.
options.zh: 修戲服帶收入，詩作有酬工作未確立。

options.en: She supports herself only through selling poems and repairs costumes without payment.
options.zh: 她只靠賣詩維生，修戲服不收錢。

options.en: Both poetry and costume work are described as equally paid jobs in the profile.
options.zh: 介紹把寫詩及戲服同說成相同有酬工作。

options.en: The profile says she no longer writes because repairing costumes is her job.
options.zh: 介紹說因修戲服是工作，她已不再寫詩。

listening.explanationZh: 明說修戲服謀生、詩私人時間，未列詩酬，不把職業抹掉愛好。

reply.promptZh: Rosa 怎維持生活？
reply.promptEn: How does Rosa support her everyday life?

options.en: She earns money by repairing costumes for theatre groups.
options.zh: 她替劇團修戲服賺錢。

options.en: She makes a living by repairing costumes, while writing poems in her own time.
options.zh: 她修戲服謀生，私人時間寫詩。

options.en: Her described income comes from costume repairs rather than confirmed paid poetry work.
options.zh: 所述收入來自戲服修補，而非已確認詩作酬勞。

options.en: Several theatre groups use her paid repair work.
options.zh: 幾個劇團用她有酬的修補工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給已說收入來源，不編詩收入或財富程度。

scene.promptZh: 故事人物白天教琴付生活開支，晚上參加無酬樂隊，仍重視兩者。你要介紹謀生來源。哪句準確？

options.en: He makes a living by teaching piano, while the band is an unpaid activity he values.
options.zh: 他教琴謀生，樂隊則是他重視的無酬活動。

options.en: His main income comes from paid performances rather than piano teaching.
options.zh: 他主要收入來自有酬演出，而非教琴。

options.en: The account does not yet identify which activity pays his everyday expenses.
options.zh: 敘述尚未指哪項活動支付他的日常開支。

scene.explanationZh: 已明說教琴付生活費，樂隊無酬但仍受重視；不能改成演出是主要收入，也不是未列收入來源。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 someone makes a living from an activity？

options.en: They earn money from that work to support daily needs.
options.zh: 他們靠該工作賺錢維持日需。

options.en: They enjoy doing it occasionally, but no income from it is reported.
options.zh: 他們偶爾享受做，卻未報有收入。

options.en: The account describes paid work as their means of support.
options.zh: 敘述把有酬工作說作維生方法。

contrast.explanationZh: 有興趣不自證謀生，需收入及維生線索。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把 Rosa 最愛寫詩，改成全靠詩收入，但資料只說修戲服維生。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the income source and the interest separate, so the profile can show both repair work and poetry honestly.
options.zh: 把收入來源與興趣分開，讓介紹如實保留修補及詩。

options.en: Ask only about poetry earnings for the profile and omit the paid costume-repair work.
options.zh: 人物介紹只問詩作收入，省有酬戲服修補工作。

options.en: Remove the poems from the profile because an unpaid interest has no place beside a paid job.
options.zh: 因無酬興趣不應跟有酬職業並列，就從介紹刪詩。

dialogue.explanationZh: 資料支持修戲服維生及寫詩興趣，應兼有兩面；只追未確立詩收入或因無酬刪詩，都失去所給生活全貌。

speaking.en: I make a living through one kind of work, but that does not describe every interest I want to keep in my life.
speaking.zh: 我靠一種工作謀生，但這未描述想在生活保留的所有興趣。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清收入來源與其他興趣。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為虛構社區人物寫短介紹，她靠上午替刊物校對、周末教小班語文共同賺生活費，還未說收入多少或哪項是唯一職業。你想讓讀者明白兩種有酬工作一起支持生活，不因有兩份工作便稱富有，也不把其中一項說成只是興趣。用一至兩句英文寫正式介紹。

examples.en: She makes a living through a combination of morning proofreading and weekend language classes. Both are paid parts of her working week, and neither alone tells the whole story of how she supports herself.
examples.zh: 她結合上午校對及周末語文課來謀生；兩者都是一周有酬工作的一部分，單看任何一項都未能完整說明她怎支持生活。

examples.en: She makes a living by proofreading for publications and teaching small language groups at weekends. Her livelihood brings the two roles together, rather than fitting into a single job title.
examples.zh: 她替刊物校對、周末教小語文班來謀生；她的生計結合兩個角色，不只一項職銜。

glossary.en: paid parts of her working week
glossary.zh: 一周有酬工作的一部分

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出兩種已在做的有酬工作共同謀生，不推收入高低、唯一職業，或把其中一項改成無酬興趣。

takeaways.en: He made a living by teaching music while continuing to compose pieces that had not been performed.
takeaways.zh: 他教音樂謀生，同時繼續寫尚未演出的樂曲。

takeaways.en: She is making a living from repair work, and she keeps a separate evening for the stories she writes for pleasure.
takeaways.zh: 她正靠修補工作謀生，並另留一晚寫自娛故事。
